name: NGP
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the DeFiHackLabs root-cause title.

descriptions.text: The NGP token (a fee-on-transfer / reflection style token) contained logic in its _update()/transfer hook that calls the PancakePair's sync() whenever the pair's NGP balance dropped below a threshold. An attacker used a flash-loaned ~211M USDT to buy a large amount of NGP and burn it to the dead address, drastically lowering the pair's real NGP balance. A second swap of NGP back to USDT triggered the internal sync() inside the token's transfer logic, forcing the pair's reserves to re-sync to the artificially depleted balance and thereby mispricing NGP. With the reserves manipulated, the attacker's remaining NGP could be drained for far more USDT than fair value, netting ~2M USDT.
